pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does proportion mean in a meal? (1 mark)
   A. The price of the food
   B. The right amount of each kind of food
   C. The colour of the food
   D. The number of plates

2. Why should the compound be free of long grass and rubbish? (1 mark)
   A. It looks colourful
   B. Snakes, rats and mosquitoes can hide there
   C. To save soap
   D. To stop rain

3. Why do we knot the end of the thread? (1 mark)
   A. To make it longer
   B. To make it stronger
   C. To colour it
   D. So it does not pull through the cloth

4. Why do some farmers tie a young tree to a stake? (1 mark)
   A. To feed it
   B. To make it thicker
   C. To keep it upright in wind
   D. To stop it growing

5. Which of these foods needs a long time of boiling before it is soft enough to eat? (1 mark)
   A. Cucumber
   B. Dry beans
   C. Tomato
   D. Ripe banana

6. What is topsoil? (1 mark)
   A. A fertiliser
   B. The dark top layer of soil
   C. The bottom layer
   D. Sand from the river

7. After about how long should the compost heap first be turned? (1 mark)
   A. One hour
   B. Two to three weeks
   C. Never
   D. One year

8. What is a good first step if a person's clothes catch fire? (1 mark)
   A. Wave the arms
   B. Stop, drop and roll on the ground
   C. Run fast
   D. Jump in the air

9. Which of these is a kitchen safety rule? (1 mark)
   A. Play around the stove
   B. Never leave cooking food alone
   C. Use wet cloths
   D. Leave water near hot oil

10. Which of these is a climbing fruit? (1 mark)
   A. Grapes
   B. Orange
   C. Guava
   D. Mango

11. Why is dry firewood better than wet firewood? (1 mark)
   A. It puts out fires
   B. It cannot burn
   C. It is heavier
   D. It burns better with less smoke

12. How often should you brush your teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Once a year
   C. Once a month
   D. Twice a day

13. Why should a poultry house be clean and dry? (1 mark)
   A. To attract rats
   B. To stop hens from laying
   C. To make eggs blue
   D. To keep birds healthy and safe

14. What is leather made from? (1 mark)
   A. Eggs
   B. Feathers
   C. Animal hides and skins
   D. Wool only

15. Why should PPE be cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Dirty PPE can carry germs
   B. Dirty PPE lasts longer
   C. To make it smell
   D. Clean PPE is heavier

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State the difference between boiling and shallow frying. (2 marks)

17. Describe how to make long and short tacking. (4 marks)

18. Explain why vegetables and fruits should be eaten every day. (3 marks)

19. Describe how a family can plant trees to help conserve fuel. (4 marks)

20. Name four fuels used for cooking in homes. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — The right amount of each kind of food
   Proportion means the right amounts.

2. B — Snakes, rats and mosquitoes can hide there
   A tidy compound is safer.

3. D — So it does not pull through the cloth
   A knot anchors the thread.

4. C — To keep it upright in wind
   Stakes protect against bending.

5. B — Dry beans
   Dry beans are hard and need long cooking.

6. B — The dark top layer of soil
   Topsoil is rich in plant food.

7. B — Two to three weeks
   Turning after a few weeks gives air and mixes the heap.

8. B — Stop, drop and roll on the ground
   Rolling smothers the flames.

9. B — Never leave cooking food alone
   Careful supervision prevents fires.

10. A — Grapes
   Grapes grow on vines.

11. D — It burns better with less smoke
   Dry wood gives more heat and less smoke.

12. D — Twice a day
   Morning and before bed.

13. D — To keep birds healthy and safe
   Dirty houses spread diseases.

14. C — Animal hides and skins
   Skins of cattle, goats and sheep become leather.

15. A — Dirty PPE can carry germs
   Clean PPE is safe and lasts longer.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Boiling cooks food in bubbling water. Shallow frying cooks food in a thin layer of hot oil in a pan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct description.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mark a line; make a long stitch of about 2 cm on top; make a short stitch of about 0.5 cm underneath; repeat along the line; finish with a small back stitch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: They give vitamins and minerals, fibre for digestion and water, so they protect the body from disease.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant fast growing trees on their land for firewood, care for them and replace any tree cut with more new trees, so wood is always available and forests are not cut.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for planting, caring, replacing and result.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Firewood, charcoal, gas and kerosene.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each fuel, total 2.
